culprit_line.instructions: The numbered entries in `lines` are the last 200 lines of a failed CI job's log, in order. Which single line number states the specific, concrete reason the job failed — the actual error, exception, assertion failure, or the specific command that returned a non-zero exit? Skip generic wrapper, summary or banner lines that only report that the job failed without saying why, such as 'npm ERR! Test failed. See above for more details.', '##[error]Process completed with exit code 1.', 'Error: Process completed with exit code N', a bare re-run/exit-status line, or pass/fail totals like '15 passing, 1 failing'. When several lines are part of one error (e.g. a message plus its stack frames), pick the line that states the message itself, not a frame below it. If two unrelated errors both appear, pick the one that occurs first. Choose 'unclear' only if no single line in `lines` states a concrete cause.
